name: populations
label: Populations
description: Patient group a dose or PK value applies to. Split these finely; PK values do not transfer between groups.

terms.label: Healthy adult
terms.note: Use for PK values measured in healthy volunteers.

terms.label: CYP2D6 poor metaboliser
terms.note: Roughly 5-10% of people of European ancestry. For a CYP2D6-cleared drug this is a different PK population, not a footnote.
